hero.title: Undergraduate Computer Engineering in Switzerland in Switzerland for Indian Students
hero.subtitle: **Bachelor’s in Computer Engineering in Switzerland for Indian Students** provides Indian students with the opportunity to gain technical skills in computer systems, software development, digital electronics, embedded systems, computer networks and hardware-software integration. Swiss universities and universities of applied sciences are famous for their technical education, research facilities and practical learning approaches.

overview:
The exact title of the degree can vary in Switzerland. Other related programs are Computer Science Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical and Information Engineering, and Information Technology. Students should check the curriculum carefully to ensure it contains their desired combination of hardware and software topics.

Please note for Indian applicants: many Swiss bachelor’s degrees are taught in German, French or Italian, not English. Admission is also based on the applicant’s school-leaving qualification, subject background, language proficiency and institution-specific requirements.

For Indian students exploring international technical education options, **Bachelor’s in Computer Engineering in Switzerland for Indian Students** is an opportunity to consider with guidance from **Edu-Hawk Worldwide**.
